compression.classical_result: INT8 was the strongest Phase 1 compression result under the frozen pilot criteria.
compression.phase1_conclusion: The quantum-inspired compression pathway was feasible but did not establish superiority over the strongest classical compression result.
compression.quantum_inspired_result: Tensor Train / MPS compression was implemented and evaluated as a quantum-inspired pathway.

cross_domain.phase1_conclusion: Cross-domain reuse is supported at the framework and interface level, not as a universal trained policy.

rl_qml.phase1_conclusion: The hybrid PQC actor was substantially smaller, but no sample-efficiency advantage was demonstrated under the frozen pilot protocol.

safety.phase1_conclusion: Strong empirical pilot safety was demonstrated, while Lyapunov-specific mechanism activation remained domain-dependent.

training_efficiency.classical_result: FP32 and trainable SVD controls were evaluated under the paired convergence protocol.
training_efficiency.phase1_conclusion: No robust >=10% training-efficiency advantage was established under the frozen Phase 1 protocol.
training_efficiency.quantum_inspired_result: Trainable TT/MPS variants were evaluated under the same training-efficiency framework.

proposal_summary: Phase 1 established a reproducible dual-domain framework covering compression, training efficiency, RL/QML, and safety. Classical baselines remained strongest on the main performance criteria, while quantum-inspired and QML paths demonstrated feasibility and compactness without establishing quantum advantage.
